# Agentplane

site: https://agentplane.org
docs: https://github.com/basilisk-labs/agentplane/blob/main/docs/index.mdx
examples: https://agentplane.org/examples
repo: https://github.com/basilisk-labs/agentplane

summary: Agentplane is the Git-native control plane for coding agents. It puts repository-capable agents on an approved, verifiable workflow with bounded authority, attributable approvals, supervisor-observed proof, deterministic recovery, and closure in Git.
promise: Let agents write code. Keep authority and proof in Git.
control-loop: authorize -> dispatch -> observe -> verify -> close or recover.
not: model provider, prompt playground, low-code chatbot builder, replacement for every agent framework, black-box runtime that hides operational state.
local-first: The default quickstart runs locally, writes repo-local artifacts, and does not require account creation.
cli: agentplane
license: MIT
